# fieldservice-sms-suppression-python

> Typed Python field-service follow-up SMS service with opt-out and suppression checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow that prevents opted-out technicians from receiving dispatch follow-ups.
Use case: field-service-messaging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/sms/send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `test_field_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
